reason: A local DSH data-management dashboard that inventories conversations, files, skills, memories, logs, trash, and browser storage, with agent-assisted inspection and user-directed cleanup.

summaries.zh: 用于统一查看和管理 DeepSeek Harness 本地数据的看板，支持来源追踪、回收站恢复与经用户确认的数据清理。
summaries.en: A dashboard for inspecting and managing DeepSeek Harness local data with source tracking, trash restoration, and user-directed cleanup.

capabilities: Scans and summarizes DSH local data
Displays data sources, locations, sizes, timestamps, and summaries
Moves selected DSH paths to a recoverable trash area
Permanently purges explicitly selected trash entries
Views and clears browser storage keys
Provides agent tools for data inspection and management
